visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair wearing an olive green long-sleeved shirt is seated at a white table. He faces the camera in a medium close-up shot. On the table, a plastic tray contains several golden-brown egg rolls next to opened silver wrappers. The background is a brightly lit living room featuring a grey sofa, a shelf filled with toys, and a large sliding glass door showing a dark night view. A fixed yellow rectangular text overlay is at the top. (2) The boy begins to speak with a saddened facial expression, his eyes slightly downcast. As he continues, he suddenly throws his head back, closes his eyes tightly, and raises both hands with palms facing upward in a dramatic display of grief. Large white text with a red border vibrates in the center of the frame. (3) The boy brings his hands down and looks back toward the food on the table, maintaining a pouting and somber expression. He reaches his right hand toward the silver wrappers. A final line of text in white appears at the bottom center of the frame, including a small smiling face emoji.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The sequence opens with a high-pitched child's voice speaking in Mandarin with a mournful and whiny prosody. The pitch is relatively high, and the delivery is slow with a clear downward emotional valence. There is no background music, and the room tone is a clean indoor environment with no noticeable interference. (2) A sudden transition occurs as the boy emits a loud, high-arousal shout of 'Bù~' (No). This vocalization is marked by significant strain and a wide pitch range. Simultaneously, a series of rapid, rhythmic, and high-intensity percussive thudding sound effects (Impact SFX) are triggered, sounding like hands hitting a table. These sounds have a broad spectral bandwidth and are prominent in the mix. (3) The shouting and impact noises cease, replaced by the same child's voice speaking in a much calmer, lower-arousal Mandarin tone. A upbeat, comedic background music track featuring a repetitive, high-register synthesizer melody begins. The music has a steady, medium tempo and a major key tonality, providing a contrast to the previous dramatic segment.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To humorously capture the universal feeling of dread when a holiday ends and work/school resumes. By using a child's dramatic 'meltdown' over the first working day of 2025, the video creates a relatable meme that contrasts intense despair with the small comfort of snacks (egg rolls).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video relies heavily on the 'POV' meme format and traditional variety show editing styles (large vibrating text and impact SFX) to enhance the comedic timing of the child's performance.
